title: Change a Shared Greentic Contract
summary: Change provider, hook, observer, static-route, or capability contracts in greentic-types with downstream validation guidance.

modules.title: Make the Change in the Owner Repo
modules.objective: Keep shared contracts centralized in greentic-types and avoid downstream copies.

steps.instruction: Identify the canonical contract type and its downstream consumers before editing.
steps.expected_output: Likely affected concepts, workflows, and validations are listed.

steps.instruction: Change the shared type and update serialization fixtures or schema examples.

modules.title: Validate Consumers
modules.objective: Run downstream checks for packs, bundles, and launchers affected by the contract.

steps.instruction: Run local CI and coverage after updating consumers or migration notes.
Document migration guidance if the serialized contract changes.
steps.expected_output: Relevant knowledge updates are visible to agents.

deprecated_commands.command: copy shared DTO into consumer repo
deprecated_commands.reason: Shared contracts are owned by greentic-types and should be imported by consumers.
deprecated_commands.replacement: change the contract in greentic-types and update consumers
